'''The Void''' was the name given to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-wide featureless [[Desert/Legends|desert]] on [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]], a remote world in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was only broken by small bodies of [[Water/Legends|water]] and a few settlements such as [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]].
